questions.stem: What does percentage cover measure when using a quadrat?

options.text: The number of individual plants in the quadrat
The proportion of the quadrat area covered by a particular species
The height of the tallest plant in the quadrat
The total mass of organisms in the quadrat

questions.explanation: Percentage cover estimates the proportion of the quadrat area that is covered by a particular species. It is useful for plants like grass or moss that are difficult to count as individuals, and is recorded as a percentage of the total quadrat area.
